simple.meaning: שָׁכַב (shâkab) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to lie down (for rest, sexual connection, decease or any other purpose).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 213 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 5 more, beginning at Genesis 19:4. Its contexts include birth, family, firstborn, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁכַב (H7901).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
